mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_event_outbox( event_type, order_id, status, send_attempts, consume_attempts, next_attempt_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{orderId}, #{status}, 0, 0, COALESCE(#{nextAttemptAt}, NOW()), NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_type, order_id, status, send_attempts, consume_attempts, next_attempt_at, sent_at, done_at, last_error, create_time, update_time FROM payment_event_outbox WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, event_type, order_id, status, send_attempts, consume_attempts, next_attempt_at, sent_at, done_at, last_error, create_time, update_time FROM payment_event_outbox WHERE status IN (0, 1) AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_event_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, send_attempts = send_attempts + 1, sent_at = #{sentAt}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
UPDATE payment_event_outbox SET send_attempts = send_attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
UPDATE payment_event_outbox SET status = 2, done_at = #{doneAt}, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
UPDATE payment_event_outbox SET consume_attempts = consume_attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, last_error = #{error}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
